1.The results for the half year ended September 30, 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the
Board of Directors in it's meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Statutory Auditors of the Company has carried out
limited review of the aforesaid results in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (listing Obligation and Disclosure
Requirements), 2015. 2 This statement has been prepared in accordance with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards)Rules, 2015 (Ind AS), prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and otherrecognised
accounting practices end policies to the extent.3. BACKGROUND
1.1GB Global Limited (CIN: L17120MH1984PLC033553) (“Transferor Company” or "GB Global") was a public company whose shares are listed on National Stock Exchange of India Limited ("NSE") and BSE Limited ("BSE"). The shares of GB Global continue to remain listed on the Stock Exchanges, although pending procedural compliance were not allowed to be traded on the exchanges despite its best efforts and pending completion of the delisting process. Accordingly, GB Global was subject to the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the “LODR Regulations”). 1.2Dev Land & Housing Private Limited (CIN: U70100MH2006PLC161220) (the “Transferee Company” or “DLH”) was the holding company of GB Global and held approximately 99.93% of the paid-up equity share capital of GB Global by way of acquisition under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the order issued by Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) and till the approval of the Scheme of Amalgamation (“Scheme”).1.3 GB Global, together with DLH, filed an application before the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench (the "Tribunal"), under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013 (the "Act"), seeking sanction of the Scheme of amalgamation of GB Global with DLH and their respective shareholders [, in Company Scheme Petition No. CP (CAA) NO. 6/MB/2026]
SANCTION AND EFFECTIVENESS OF THE SCHEME
1.4By its order dated 12 August 2026 (the "Order"), the Tribunal sanctioned the Scheme pursuant to which GB Global was amalgamated and merged with DLH.1.5On the Effective Date, GB Global stood amalgamated with DLH, and its undertaking, including all its assets, liabilities, rights and obligations, stood transferred to and vested in DLH [in terms of Clause 7.2 of the Scheme. 1.6GB Global and DLH received the certified copy of the Order on 01st September 2026 and filed it with the Registrar of Companies, Mumbai, in e-Form INC-28 on 11tth September 2026, in compliance with Section 232(5) of the Act for giving effect to the Scheme.
DISSOLUTION OF GB GLOBAL
1.7Paragraph 43 of the Order provides:
"The Transferor Company is dissolved without winding up."
1.8Accordingly, in terms of the Order read with Section 232(3)(d) of the Act, GB Global stood dissolved without winding up and has ceased to exist as a legal entity. The master data of GB Global maintained by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs reflects its status as "Amalgamated". It is settled law that, upon amalgamation, the amalgamating company ceases to exist in the eye of law: Saraswati Industrial Syndicate Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income Tax, (1990) 186 ITR 278 (SC); Principal Commissioner of Income Tax v. Maruti Suzuki India Ltd., (2019) 416 ITR 613 (SC).
DELISTING OF THE EQUITY SHARES OF GB GLOBAL
1.9In terms of Clause 3.3 of the Scheme, the equity shares of GB Global are required to be delisted from the Stock Exchanges in accordance with the applicable provisions of the SEBI (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021 (the "Delisting Regulations").
1.10As GB Global has been dissolved, it cannot itself take any step towards delisting that the Delisting Regulations require of an issuer. DLH, as successor to GB Global under the Scheme, will take such steps, and furnish such documents and undertakings, as the Stock Exchanges may require to complete the delisting.
LISTING OBLIGATIONS
1.11As GB Global has ceased to exist, it cannot make, in its own name, the filings and disclosures prescribed under the LODR Regulations.
1.12The obligations of GB Global that accrued up to the Delisting of GB Global stand vested in DLH under the Scheme. DLH is accordingly making the filings in respect of those obligations.
1.13For periods after the delisting of GB Global, there is no listed entity to which the LODR Regulations apply. Any filing that DLH makes in respect of such periods made is restricted to operations of G B Global only (and not entire DLH) and to keep the records of the Stock Exchanges complete pending the delisting, and not in any manner acknowledgement of any continuing obligation.
CORRESPONDENCE WITH THE STOCK EXCHANGES
1.14DLH, being the successor-in-interest to GB Global, has communicated to the Stock Exchanges through various emails and telephonic discussions, seeking guidance and clarification regarding the pending listing compliances and the procedure and documentation required for completing the delisting of the equity shares of GB Global pursuant to the Order and the Scheme.
1.15However, despite repeated communications and follow-ups, no specific guidance or definitive resolution in respect of the aforesaid matters has been received from the Stock Exchanges as on the date. .
AUTHORITY OF DLH
1.16DLH makes this Note and the accompanying filings in its own name, as successor-in-interest to GB Global under the Scheme, on the basis of:
(a)the Order read with Section 232 of the Act, under which the undertaking, liabilities and obligations of GB Global stand vested in DLH;(b)Clause 14.2 and 17 of the Scheme, which authorises DLH to execute and file all documents, and to make all compliances, in the name of or in respect of GB Global as may be required to give effect to the Scheme; and
(c)the resolution passed by the Board of Directors of GB Global at its meeting held on 3 September, 2026, authorising DLH to sign and submit this Note accompanying the filings.
1.17In addition, the Board of Directors of GB Global, at its meeting held on authorised DLH to undertake all such acts, deeds, matters and things, including the execution and submission of applications, forms, documents and requisite compliances, as may be necessary or expedient for giving effect to and implementing the Scheme.
UNDERTAKING AND RESERVATION
1.18DLH undertakes to (i) furnish any further information or documents that the Stock Exchanges may require; (ii) address the grievances of the shareholders of the erstwhile GB Global, including those received on SCORES; and (iii) take all steps required of it to complete the delisting.
1.19This note is submitted without prejudice to the rights and contentions and any obligation under LoDR on the part of DLH, including its right to seek such directions from the Tribunal under Section 231 of the Act as may be necessary for the implementation of the Scheme.
